title: Tokyo vs London: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Tokyo wins for food, safety, value, and culture shock. London wins for ease, English, and European access. Tokyo daily budget: ¥8,000–15,000 (~$55–100 USD). London: £100–160/day (~$125–200 USD).

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Tokyo has more Michelin stars than any city on Earth. London has excellent diverse multicultural food. Tokyo wins clearly at every price tier.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Tokyo is ~40-50% cheaper than London in 2026 thanks to the weak yen.

categories.name: Safety
categories.summary: Tokyo is one of the safest mega-cities on Earth. London is safe but has petty crime.

categories.name: Free Museums
categories.summary: London has world-class free museums (British Museum, V&A, Natural History). Tokyo charges admission.

categories.name: Transit
categories.summary: Tokyo metro is world-class in punctuality and frequency. London Tube is excellent but aging.

categories.name: Language
categories.summary: London is English. Tokyo requires navigation skills but is very tourist-friendly.

faq.question: Is Tokyo or London better for first-time travelers?
faq.answer: London is easier. Tokyo is more impactful. Choose based on experience level and appetite for adventure.

faq.question: Which is cheaper, Tokyo or London?
faq.answer: Tokyo is significantly cheaper — ~40-50% less than London in 2026 thanks to the weak yen.
